title: List of equipment sets/Classes
html:
This page lists equipment sets by class.

See also: Category:Equipment sets (Classes)

Barbarian set

Main article: Barbarian set

The Barbarian set includes items that interact with Barbarian mechanics. The Bonespike set and Wrath set are part of it, but those items are not duplicated here.

  • Reason's Grasp: Gain 15  temporary hit points when choosing to  End Rage.

Bard (Bardic Inspiration) set

Main article: Bard set

The Bard set includes items that interact with Bard mechanics.

  • Blazer of Benevolence: when you inspire an ally using Bardic Inspiration, you gain 4 temporary hit points
  • Boots of Brilliance: play your instrument to restore one of your Bardic Inspiration slots (Recharge: Long Rest).
  • Cap of Curing: when you inspire an ally using Bardic Inspiration, they also regain 1d6 hit points.
  • Wondrous Gloves: gain one more use of Bardic Inspiration.

Cleric set

Main article: Cleric set

The Cleric set includes items that interact with Cleric mechanics, are only obtainable by clerics, or inflict the   Turned condition.

  • Amulet of the Devout: Gain an extra  Channel Divinity Charge charge and + 2 Spell Save DC.
  • Circlet of Hunting: Gain a +1d4 bonus to  Attack Rolls against creatures marked by  Guiding Bolt.
  • Devotee's Mace: May use  Healing Incense Aura. Only obtainable through  Divine Intervention.
  • Gandrel's Aspiration: May use  Sacred Munitions.
  • The Sacred Star: May  Turn Undead on hit.
  • Veil of the Morning: May  Turn Undead. Undead have disadvantage when attacking. Advantage on saves caused by Undead.

Druid set

Main article: Druid set

The Druid set includes items that interact with Druid mechanics or enhance shapeshifting and disguise.

  • Armour of Landfall: May cast  Plant Growth. Heal 1d4⁠⁠Hit Points when standing on  Plant Growth or  Vines.
  • Armour of Moonbasking: Gain  22 temporary hit points after casting  Wild Shape and reduce incoming damage by 1 while those temporary hit points are active. Gain +2  Armour Class and  Advantage on  Saving Throws against spells; persists while in  Wild Shape.
  • Armour of the Sporekeeper: May spread  Bibberbang Spores,  Timmask Spores, and  Haste Spores. Gains +1 Spell Save DC and deal an additional 1⁠⁠Necrotic damage when dealing ⁠Necrotic damage.
  • Ironwood Club: Deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage when  Shillelagh is active.
  • Ironvine Shield: Deal ⁠Piercing damage when hit in melee while  Shillelagh is active.
  • Mutilated Carapace: Gain a +1 to Attack and Damage rolls while shapeshifting or disguised.
  • Pale Oak: May cast  Faithwarden's Vines. Druidic vines cannot  Ensnare you and do not count as  difficult terrain. Only obtainable by druid player character.
  • Shapeshifter Hat: Gain an additional use of  Wild Shape.
  • Shapeshifter's Boon Ring: Gain a +1d4 bonus to all  Ability Checks while shapeshifting.

Fighter set

Main article: Fighter set

The Fighter set includes items that interact with Fighter mechanics.

  • Charge-Bound Warhammer: Deal an additional 1d6⁠⁠Lightning when bound by an Eldritch Knight.
  • Gauntlets of Surging Accuracy: Gain a +1d4 bonus to  Attack Rolls for the rest of your turn when you use  Action Surge.
  • Gauntlets of the Warmaster: Targets have  Disadvantage on  Saving Throws against your Manoeuvre and Weapon Actions.

Monk set

Main article: Monk set

The Monk set includes items that interact with Monk mechanics. See also Kushigo set, Soul set, Unarmed set, Drunk set, and List of features and items that interact with unarmed strikes.

  • Armour of Uninhibited Kushigo: May use a reaction to make an unarmed strike against an attacker that misses while  Patient Defence is active.
  • Garb of the Land and Sky: Gain  Blade Ward when using  Patient Defence. The next  Attack Roll has  Advantage and deals an additional 1d8⁠⁠Force damage after using  Step of the Wind.
  • Sentient Amulet (Rare): May use  Ki Restoration (Lesser).
  • Sentient Amulet (Very Rare): May use  Ki Restoration (Greater).

Paladin set

Main article: Paladin set

The Paladin set includes items that interact with Paladin mechanics.

  • Armour of Devotion: May use  Eternal Devotion.
  • Blackguard's Sword: May  Daze a target hit with a Smite.
  • Gloves of Heroism: Gain  Heroism when using Channel Oath Charge.
  • Helmet of Smiting: Gain  temporary hit points equal to Charisma modifer when applying a condition via a Smite spell.

Ranger set

Main article: Ranger set

The Ranger set includes items that interact with Ranger mechanics.

  • Circlet of Hunting: Gain a +1d4 bonus to  Attack Rolls against creatures marked by  Hunter's Mark.

Rogue set

Main article: Rogue set

The Rogue set includes items that interact with Rogue mechanics.

  • Stalker Gloves:  Sneak Attack deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Force damage.

Sorcerer set

Main article: Sorcerer set

The Sorcerer set includes items that interact with Sorcerer mechanics.

  • Ring of Feywild Sparks: Always trigger  Wild Magic while  Tides of Chaos is active.
  • Spellseeking Gloves: Gain access to  Seeking Spell.

Warlock set

Main article: Warlock set

The Warlock set includes items that interact with Warlock mechanics.

  • Caitiff Staff: Gain access to  Caitiff's Restoration.
  • Charge-Bound Warhammer: Deal an additional 1d6⁠⁠Lightning when bound as a  Pact Weapon.
  • The Baneful: Possibly inflict  Bane on-hit when bound as a  Pact Weapon.

Wizard set

Main article: Wizard set

The Wizard set includes items that interact with Wizard mechanics.

  • The Pointy Hat: Gain a bonus to your  Persuasion Checks equal to your  Intelligence Modifier.
  • Warped Headband of Intellect: Set your  Intelligence score to 17.
